name: io.github.tonyyang0504/vimeo-mcp
description: Vimeo (social): me, read_comments, delete, analytics_post. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_VIMEO_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Vimeo personal access token (developer.vimeo.com > My Apps > your app > Generate an access token, authenticated, scopes public private edit delete interact stats) or an OAuth authorization-code token; Vimeo access tokens do not expire unless revoked. Sent as 'Authorization: bearer <token>'.
